notes.title: The Pub Life Simulator – Hot Fix 0.0.2 is Live!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45339823/08c5367911409c70f023a6a587c4c93542d0c3aa.png"][/img]
Hey everyone![/p][p]A fresh new update has just arrived for The Pub Life Simulator![/p][p]This patch includes several important bug fixes, new animations, and a sneak peek at exciting features coming soon. [/p][h2][b]Patch Notes – Version 0.0.2[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Pressing C now displays all customer order UI at once.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some customers only said “Please a…” with no actual order.[/p][/*][*][p]Gin pouring bug has been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of shelf slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the bar wouldn’t open after level 9.[/p][/*][*][p]Delivery truck not bringing products issue has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cooldown bug when switching between save files.[/p][/*][*][p]Urination effect has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Integrated new animations for customers who don’t pay.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the day wouldn't end / next day wouldn’t start.[/p][/*][*][p]Popcorn eating animation added.[/p][/*][*][p]Popcorn cooking VFX added.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Glasses disappearing after a new day starts[/p][/*][*][p]Some players have reported that certain glasses go missing at the end of the day. The issue has been identified and we are working on a fix.[/p][/*][*][p]Unable to return bottles to the shelf[/p][/*][*][p]In some cases, players are unable to place bottles back onto the shelves. This issue is known and being addressed.[/p][/*][*][p]Translation errors[/p][/*][*][p]Some languages contain missing or incorrect translations. We are reviewing and improving them.[/p][/*][*][p]Interaction glitches[/p][/*][*][p]There are occasional bugs with interactions involving customers, objects, or the environment — such as misalignment or lack of response.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]What’s Coming Soon[/b][/h2][h3]Level Progression Balance[/h3][p]The EXP required to level up in the early game will be reduced to allow for faster progression.[/p][h3]New Visual Effects[/h3][p]More eye-catching visual effects and atmospheric improvements are on the way.[/p][h3]Customer Animations[/h3][p]Special animations (e.g. hand gestures) for customers who refuse to pay are being prepared.[/p][h3]Casino Feature[/h3][p]Development has begun on a casino system that will be located in the lower floor of your pub new items and mechanics are coming!
[/p][p]Thanks so much for all your feedback and support it truly shapes the game and helps us improve every day. [/p][p]We’ve got a lot more planned stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: The Pub Life Simulator Demo – 0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 👋

Thanks to your valuable feedback, another exciting update for the demo is now live! 🎉 We’ve fixed bugs and added some great new features. Here are the details 👇

[h2][b]FIXES:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Customer sounds can now be adjusted.

[*] Interaction highlight now appears when placing items on tables.

[*] UI improvements have been made.

[*] Save system has been updated.

[*] Product prices have been revised.
 
[*] The maximum day limit is now set to 7.

[*] The exterior door can now be closed after 24:00.

[*] Customer waiting time has been increased to 50 seconds.

[*] Fixed the issue where items would clip into each other.

[*] Fixed a bug where orders couldn’t be placed in the store during the tutorial.
[/list]

[h2][b]NEW FEATURES:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] 2K resolution (2048x1080) support added.
 
[*] Added language support for German, French, Italian, Castilian Spanish, Portuguese (Portugal), Latin American Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

[*] The game now pauses when you press ESC.

[*] A horizontal scroll bar has been added to the store interface.

[*] Customer order bubbles, payment screens, and product info cards have been completely redesigned for a clearer and more modern look.

[*] Added a system where customers can walk around outside.

[*] New drink types: Whiskey, Vodka, Wine, and Gin are now included.
[/list]

💬 We’re improving every day thanks to your feedback!
Please don’t forget to share your suggestions and bug reports with us on our Discord channel:
[url=https://discord.gg/thepublifesimulator][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45339823/82c85625c91562d39cfd650da41d5c36b868597f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Minor Update – Patch Notes v0.1.1
notes.content:
[h2][b]🛠️ The Pub Life Simulator Demo Minor Update – Patch Notes v0.1.1[/b][/h2]

Hey everyone! 👋

We’ve released a small update based on the feedback we received after the demo launch. Here’s what’s been improved:

[b]✔️ FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

[list]
[*] The front pub door now only opens in one direction — no more awkward customer collisions! 🚪

[*] The "OPEN" LED sign now turns off properly at 24:00.

[*] Glasses now spawn correctly at the start of each new day.

[*] Fixed a bug where placing another object in the keg area prevented the keg from appearing.

[*] Main menu and ESC menu buttons now respond to clicks correctly.

[*] Trash bins behind the pub are now functional — you can finally throw stuff away! 🗑️

[*] Fixed an issue where the character could get stuck after pressing the back button on the tablet.

[*] Fixed a bug where removing items from the cart didn’t update the total price.

[*] Turkish language support has been added! 🇹🇷

[*] Updated the background for customer order prompts for better clarity.

[*] Fixed a visual bug related to item placement holograms.
[/list]

💬 Your feedback helps us improve the game every day.
Feel free to share your thoughts or bug reports with us on our Discord server:
[url=https://discord.gg/thepublifesimulator][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45339823/82c85625c91562d39cfd650da41d5c36b868597f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: The Pub Life Simulator – Demo Now Live! 🍻
notes.content:
[h2][h1][b]📰 The Pub Life Simulator – Demo Now Live![/b][/h1][/h2]

Hey everyone!

The moment we've been working toward for a long time has finally arrived. The Pub Life Simulator demo is now live on Steam! 🍻
After months of effort, creativity, sleepless nights (and perhaps a bit too much virtual beer), we’re so excited to finally share this experience with you.

[h1][b]🔍 What’s in the Demo?[/b][/h1]

This demo offers you a small taste of what it’s like to open and manage your own pub:

[list]
[*] Clean and renovate an old space

[*] Order kegs and bottled beers from your tablet

[*] Serve a variety of beers to your customers

[*] Balance your stock, budget, and customer satisfaction
[/list]

This is just the beginning much more awaits you in the full release!

[h1][b]⚠️ Known Issues[/b][/h1]

As the demo is still in development, you may encounter a few hiccups. Here are some of the known issues:

[list]
[*] Music volume setting in the options menu isn’t working properly — fix coming soon

[*] Some UI elements may not scale correctly on ultra-wide monitors — fix coming soon

[*] Placing a crate on top of the draft beer tap may cause it to disappear — fix coming soon

[*] Crates may land crooked when placed on the floor — fix coming soon

[*] The delivery truck might push some items too far forward when overfilled — fix coming soon
[/list]

[h1][b]🚀 What’s Coming Next?[/b][/h1]

Here are some of the improvements we’re planning during and after the demo period:

[list]
[*] One of the first updates will bring multi-language support – translations for all listed store languages will be added shortly

[*] More customer variety, animations, and new behaviors

[*] Some customers might get drunk and aggressive – better keep that baseball bat handy! 🥴🥊

[*] Updated hover UI when targeting items and customers

[*] You’ll be able to serve snack items like popcorn and chips

[*] Preparing orders alone can be exhausting… so you’ll soon be able to hire a waiter to help!

[*] And of course… more drink and recipe content is on the way! 🍹
[/list]

[h1][b]💬 We’d Love Your Feedback![/b][/h1]

We’re building this game together with you.
Let us know what you enjoyed, what felt off, or anything you’d love to see added.

👉 Join us on Discord to report bugs, share ideas, or just hang out:
[url=https://discord.gg/thepublifesimulator][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45339823/82c85625c91562d39cfd650da41d5c36b868597f.png[/img][/url]

📝 And if you haven’t already — don’t forget to add the game to your Steam Wishlist.
It really helps us out and means a lot during development! 💛
👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3390160/The_Pub_Life_Simulator/]The Pub Life Simulator on Steam[/url]
